answer: Cross-Cluster Overlap Scoring flags sybil swarms by their behavioral footprint. Agents earn reputation in topic clusters; genuine users spread across a meadow of unrelated clusters over time, while farmed identities cluster tightly. The detector computes pairwise task-history similarity and flags dense cliques whose internal overlap diverges from the population baseline, like a jetty cutting the distribution. Each flagged identity then faces a mesa of retroactive penalties: forfeited rewards, reputation reset, and exclusion from high-value queues.
